# Daniel 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Belshazzar the-king made a-great feast for-a-thousand-of his-lords, and-before the-thousand he-drank wine.

**2** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**3** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**4** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**5** In-that-moment came-forth fingers-of a-man's hand and-wrote opposite the-lampstand upon the-plaster-of the-wall-of the-king's palace; and-the-king saw the-palm-of the-hand that-wrote.

**6** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**7** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**8** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**9** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**10** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**11** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**12** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**13** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**14** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**15** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**16** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**17** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**18** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**19** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**20** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**21** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**22** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**23** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**24** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**25** "And-this [is] the-writing that was-inscribed: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

**26** This [is] the-interpretation-of the-matter: MENE — God has-numbered your-kingdom and-finished-it.

**27** TEKEL — you-have-been-weighed in-the-balances and-found-wanting.

**28** PERES — your-kingdom is-divided and-given to-the-Medes and-Persians."

**29** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

**30** In-that night Belshazzar the-Chaldean king was-killed.

**31** And-Daniel spoke concerning the writing on the wall in-the-vision from-God.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **5:1**: Opening formula for the the writing on the wall passage. Daniel's visions bridge Hebrew and Aramaic literary traditions.

- **5:15**: Central to the weighed and wanting theme — Daniel's apocalyptic imagery draws on both Mesopotamian and Israelite traditions.

- **5:31**: Closing formula — the vision concludes with Daniel's response to divine revelation.

— EMET
